text: {"score":2,"justification":"The numbers match the card and tool outputs, and the next steps and cautious wording are reasonable. But the rationale contradicts itself on the leaning and on the audit trail, and the evidence does not fit the headline. The headline says audit-trail signals are low and charts support billing, while the body says the summary rule leaned toward upcoding, and the final leaning is 'inconclusive'. The investigator gets mixed messages and has to work out which one holds. The rationale also repeats itself (the 21.2% vs 1.7% share and the 0 of 50 charts figures each appear twice).","problems":["Headline claims audit-trail signals are low, but the same summary says the summary rule leaned toward upcoding and the tool output shows looks_inflated true. Late notes at 20% and problems at 44% are not low.","The rationale says 'leaning toward upcoding' while the leaning field is 'inconclusive'; the summary never explains how it reconciled the two.","Redundant text: the 99215 share vs expected and the 0 of 50 charts figures are each stated twice.","The cited examples C0053286 and C0053300 are low-complexity 99215 claims, but the summary does not say whether charts were returned for them. The documented supported 99215 examples (C0053368, C0053441) are not mentioned, though C0053368 and C0053441 are in the low-complexity list and the charts showed high MDM, which undercuts the low-complexity point.","The problems-addressed examples C0053442, C0053326 and C0053444 are not on the evidence card, and the summary does not say what they show. The next steps do not tie to them.","The summary does not flag the MISSING_RESULTS deficiency in round 3 or the earlier missing visits. The 'audit trail' statement is uncaveated even though note_checks earlier said the audit trail was not received.","The next step asks for a targeted sample of 99215 charts, but 25 documented 99215 claims already exist and none were below the billed level, so the added value is unclear."]}
